abstract: Percutaneous fine needle aspiration biopsy was performed at retrograde pyelography in order to differentiate between metastatic and scarry involvement of a strictured ureter in a patient earlier operated upon because of malignant teratoma. The method is recommended in patients with malignant diseases where the differential diagnosis is impossible to establish at retrograde pyelography or urography.
abstract_ja: 悪性奇形腫の既往がある患者において、狭窄した尿管の転移性浸潤と瘢痕性変化を鑑別するため、逆行性腎盂造影の際に透視下で経皮的細針吸引生検を施行した。鑑別診断が逆行性腎盂造影や尿路造影では確定できない悪性疾患の患者には、この方法を推奨する。
